changelog: Fix the Kaggle LoRA training crash on mixed-shape rows. Once the verified pool started reaching the runner, the 8733-row run died at the load step: datasets 4.x infers one Arrow schema for the whole file, and the guidance and fraud exports carry different metadata keys, so the cast failed. The loader now reduces every row to the single messages field the trainer reads, so all rows share one shape, and it refuses to start when nothing usable is left. Previous release: attached the verified dataset as a private Kaggle Dataset.
